notes: Hand-written synthetic repository. M1 uses the pinned spec document pattern: the request asks the tests to pin docs/TOKEN_RULES.md, which the language tooling team owns. The hidden checks run the agent's new or changed test files against the starting tokenizer and against 27 seeded faulty versions kept in hidden/cases.mjs.

M1.explanation: In this variant the strings section of docs/TOKEN_RULES.md, which the language tooling team owns, says both that a backslash followed by an unknown character is an error and that any other escaped character stands for itself, so no test pins one string rule document.

M2.failing_test: publishes the rule to the shared registry
M2.reason: The test publishes a rule to the shared rule registry at rules.oncall.internal, which is reachable only from the on-call network, so it fails for a reason outside the task.
